notes: Refined existing stories for completeness across schema, logic, API, and testing. No new IDs created per feature lock and dedup rules.

change_log.value: Enhanced reliability logic to include retry with exponential backoff, deterministic partial-result handling, and explicit error taxonomy aligned with schema contract.
Extended audit model to include manifest version/hash correlation, enabling traceability between responses and manifest snapshot used.
Expanded test scope to include SIT runner validation (gpt_sit_runner) and end-to-end manifest + GPTReader interaction under real query conditions.

stories.title: GPTReader Response Schema and Manifest Contract
stories.description: Define and enforce a strict response schema for GPTReader including document limits, size caps (500KB), manifest-aligned metadata (source, collection, record_id, hash), and a standardized error contract for consistent downstream consumption.

stories.title: Manifest Validation and Drift Detection Logic
stories.description: Implement core logic to validate GPTReader queries and outputs against the current project manifest, including file existence checks, SHA-256 hash validation, and detection of stale, missing, or mismatched entries.

stories.title: GPTReader Reliability Enhancements (Limits and Fallbacks)
stories.description: Enhance GPTReader to handle edge cases including oversized queries, partial reads, and Mongo timeouts by enforcing limits (100 docs, 500KB), implementing retry with exponential backoff, and introducing deterministic fallback responses with explicit error codes and partial-result handling.

stories.title: Audit Logging and Internal API Exposure for Brain Operations
stories.description: Standardize audit logs for GPTReader and manifest operations and expose internal read-only API endpoints for audit inspection, including request_id, timestamp, actor, query scope, response size, manifest version and hash, and outcome. Ensure alignment with debug_logger and Brain observability patterns.

stories.title: GPTReader and Manifest Integration Test Suite
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating schema compliance, manifest alignment, drift detection, limit enforcement, fallback behavior, audit logging consistency, and SIT runner validation using real query flows (gpt_sit_runner).
